description: Backpacking prepares you to travel self-sufficiently on multi-day treks: trail health, lightweight gear, crew organization and safety, Leave No Trace, water, navigation, weather, stoves and meals, packing, and a series of treks building to a five-day trip.

safety.note: Treks need an approved plan, an emergency response plan and appropriate adult leadership.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Trail health
requirements.summary: Preventing and treating health problems on the trail, such as heat and cold reactions and blisters.

requirements.title: Gear and weight
requirements.summary: The Scout Basic Essentials and ways to reduce pack weight and bulk.

requirements.title: Crew organization and safety
requirements.summary: Crew size, organizing a crew, reducing risk and emergency response plans.

requirements.title: Leave No Trace
requirements.summary: Leave No Trace and the Outdoor Code on treks, and handling waste and personal cleanliness.

requirements.title: Water
requirements.summary: Treating water by two methods and staying hydrated.

requirements.title: Navigation
requirements.summary: Reading a topographic map and finding your position with a map and compass or GPS.

requirements.title: Weather
requirements.summary: Preparing for and handling bad weather on a trek.

requirements.title: Stoves and meals
requirements.summary: Stove types and fuels, safe stove use, cooking trail meals and storing food.

requirements.title: Planning and packing
requirements.summary: A short hike schedule, inspecting patrol gear, packing and fitting your pack, and a loaded practice hike.

requirements.title: Treks
requirements.summary: Several multi-day treks of the required length.

requirements.title: An extended trek
requirements.summary: Planning and completing a longer trek with a budget and a service project, and keeping a journal.
